pageCommands.addTable: Register a table from one of your sources, so it can be queried and governed.
pageCommands.addView: Define a view: a governed dataset computed from SQL or from metrics.
pageCommands.addRelationship: Declare a join between two tables, so queries can follow it.
pageCommands.clearRejections: Let the suggestions you rejected be suggested again.
pageCommands.addSource: Connect a database, file, API or service as a source of tables.
pageCommands.addCommand: Define a command: an action callers run, such as a write or a function call.
pageCommands.addRole: Add a role that is granted rights, or one derived from a user attribute.
pageCommands.addDataProduct: Publish tables as a data product with an owner, output ports and a contract.
pageCommands.productMap: Draw every data product, its tables and the links between them as one graph.
pageCommands.addMetric: Define a metric: a named measure every query computes the same way.
pageCommands.invite: Invite a person by email and choose the roles they hold.
pageCommands.glossaryDomains: Show only the terms of the domains you pick.
pageCommands.reviewsDue: Show only the documents whose review date has passed.
pageCommands.reembedAll: Recompute the search embeddings of the documents read with an older model.
pageCommands.addDocument: Add a document whose text the glossary and agents can cite.
pageCommands.addDomain: Add a domain: a group of tables with its own owners and rights.
pageCommands.addPackageRegistry: Add a registry that code sources install their packages from.
pageCommands.addOrg: Create an organization with its own users, data and settings.
pageCommands.addInvite: Invite a person to create or join an organization.
pageCommands.addScheduledTask: Schedule a webhook or an SQL statement to run on a cron.
pageCommands.addClassificationKind: Add a kind the profiler can classify a column as.
pageCommands.addReport: Add a report: a view of the ops domain, read on this page.
pageCommands.addRegion: Declare a region: an engine and its stores in one place.
pageCommands.addContainerRegistry: Add a registry that code resolver images are pulled from.
pageCommands.addSecret: Store a secret that configuration refers to by its name.
pageCommands.addTag: Add a tag to label tables, columns and terms.
pageCommands.addEnvironment: Create an environment: a copy of the model to change and test before you merge it.
pageCommands.addSyncTarget: Add a catalog the model is published to.
